# criblio_notification_policy (Resource)

NotificationPolicy Resource

Requires V2 Notifications. Configure `conditions` using `jsonencode(...)` to represent nested arrays of condition objects. Outer groups are combined with OR; conditions inside each group with AND. Values may be strings, numbers, booleans, or null.

Each template/target pair must reference existing entities with matching target types. Lower `order` values are evaluated first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "criblio_notification_target" "example" {
  id = "monitor-policy-target"
  sns_target = {
    id                        = "monitor-policy-target"
    type                      = "sns"
    region                    = "us-east-1"
    destination_type          = "topic"
    topic_type                = "standard"
    topic_arn                 = "arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:monitor-alerts"
    aws_authentication_method = "auto"
    allowlist                 = []
  }
}

resource "criblio_notification_template" "example" {
  id      = "monitor-policy-template"
  type    = "sns"
  content = "[{{status}}] {{monitor_name}}"
}

resource "criblio_notification_policy" "example" {
  id              = "platform-alert-routing"
  order           = 10
  disabled        = false
  final           = true
  wait_to_group   = 0
  group_by_labels = ["host"]
  conditions = jsonencode([
    [{ key = "team", operator = "=", value = "platform" }]
  ])
  template_target_pairs = [{
    target_id   = criblio_notification_target.example.id
    template_id = criblio_notification_template.example.id
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tools/codegen -->
## Schema

### Required

- `conditions` (String)
- `id` (String) Unique identifier.
- `order` (Number) Evaluation order of this policy. Policies with lower numbers are evaluated first.
- `template_target_pairs` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--template_target_pairs))

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, this policy is skipped during evaluation. Otherwise, <code>false</code>.
- `final` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, this is the last policy to apply; no policies below it are evaluated or combined. Otherwise, <code>false</code>.
- `group_by_labels` (List of String)
- `wait_to_group` (Number) How long, in minutes, to wait after the first alert before sending a Notification, allowing the system to group similar alerts.

<a id="nestedatt--template_target_pairs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `template_target_pairs`

Required:

- `target_id` (String) The <code>id</code> of the Notification target to send the Notification to.
- `template_id` (String) The <code>id</code> of the Notification template to use.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = criblio_notification_policy.my_criblio_notification_policy
  id = "example"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import criblio_notification_policy.example platform-alert-routing
```
